description: Nested ranked blocks retain their common outside identity (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(outer)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), same), ¬matches(without-elision($x), flat)
%rule outer left ≻ right
%rule left inner
%rule right X [+V]
%rule inner a ≻ b
%rule a X [+T]
%rule b X [+U]
%rule same outer
%rule flat X [+T]
